facts.fact: 周五下午三点，KRAY 与 BUTTONFLY 坐在大紫绒椅里，总部星巴克空无一人。
facts.anchor: It was 3:00 o’clock on Friday afternoon, so the Headquarters Starbucks was deserted.

facts.fact: ARISTOTLE 曾试图辞职，是 BUTTONFLY 劝他打消了念头。
BUTTONFLY 说 Alice G. PEACHTREE 把 ARISTOTLE 送进他的圈子，帮他成为自己一伙的人。
facts.anchor: Alice G. PEACHTREE sent him into my orbit

facts.fact: KRAY 直到在罗马见 BRAVESOUL 九个月后、即两个月前，才被告知通信系统被破。
facts.anchor: It was two months earlier, nine months after his meeting with BRAVESOUL in Rome, that KRAY had finally been told about the commo compromise.

facts.fact: IOD 军官告诉 KRAY：约五个月前，那套通信系统上的两打伊朗特工突然停止联络，包括 BRAVESOUL。
facts.anchor: About five months ago two dozen Iranian agents on that commo system suddenly stopped communicating.

facts.fact: D. B. Cooper 把 KRAY 拉到一边，说 Wacker 声称 GOOWIKI 下已有部署，而 KRAY 所见并无部署。
BUTTONFLY 说该机构官方名称是 Reindeer Games，这让国会成了不许加入的 Rudolph。
facts.anchor: which I guess puts Congress in the role of Rudolph

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 说他知道哪些人可信、能帮 KRAY，必要时可联系他拿一份可信人员名单。
facts.anchor: Well there I can help you. I know who those people are.
